skills.name: Get Serious!
skills.description: Smacks enemies hard with a paper fan.  *Cancels enemy buffs   *Enemy Skill Resistance -40% (10 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

skills.name: Terakado Guards Leader!
skills.description: Takes out fan club merchandise to support allies. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +25% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: GINTAMA
abilities.description: GINTAMA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
